description: Rolling stay-limit math such as the Schengen 90/180 rule: days used in the window, days left, overstay check, the longest stay allowed from a planned entry date, and the next date a full stay is possible. Entry and exit days both count. Custom rules via max_days/window_days. Use for travel planning, visa-free stays and "can I enter on". First 25 calls per day are free, then $0.001 per call (x402).

trips.description: Past and planned stays. Entry and exit days both count as days present.

window_days.description: Length of the rolling window, counted back from each day (inclusive)

name: stay_calculator

days_used.description: Days present in the window ending on date

first_overstay.description: First day any trip broke the rule, or null

next_full_stay_date.description: Earliest date after date from which a full max_days stay is allowed

title: Visa stay calculator (Schengen 90/180)
